description: The real emergency number and crisis lines for a country. Use FIRST, before any other tool, when someone speaks of harming themselves or others or is in danger. Never defaults to a country: ask if unknown. Example: {country:"Kenya"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/get_crisis_help. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
